# WO-189: Keep developer scheduler examples aligned with the renderer (CP-35)
Status: review
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Hannah Cole
Source: CP-35 / freemyid-pm#160; candidate reviewed by Amara Okoye and Owen Brooks

## Goal
Add an offline regression test that keeps the scheduler examples on the developer home page aligned with the renderer's documented settings.

## Acceptance criteria
- Add `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_home_scheduler_examples.py`.
- Compare only the page's cron and systemd example text with the public renderer constants/output in `src/freemyid/scheduler/render.py` and the command definition in `src/freemyid/scheduler/__init__.py` as needed.
- Cover the daily hour, rendered command, systemd unit/timer name, persistence, and randomized delay where shown by the page.
- Account for the page's human-readable cron example omitting the renderer's `# freemyid-recheck` maintenance marker; avoid brittle whole-string equality where the page intentionally simplifies output.
- Keep checks offline and text-only. Do not invoke or install a scheduler, cron, systemd, or launchd; do not edit production source or the page.
- Run focused pytest and Ruff; record exact commands/results in the worktree `VENDOR_STATUS.md`.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_home_scheduler_examples.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No changes to `src/`, `web/src/`, scheduler behavior, page copy, tests outside the new file, CI, config, or dependencies. Do not read or reveal private data. Do not run scheduled tasks or mutate a host scheduler.

## Check-in plan
Worktree `.vendor-wt/wo-189` on `vendor/wo-189`, based on latest owner-prepared local main. Confirm the worktree exists before editing. Report any observed source/page mismatch to Nora without changing source. Post results on issue #160; Nora updates `docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md`.

## Notes and decisions
- User directed Nora to create scoped follow-up work orders for the Codex team. This formalizes CP-35; no implementation starts until the owner-prepared worktree is available.
